content:
Deadline reports that Apple TV will take over Hall H for the first time at this year’s San Diego Comic-Con International, with panels, screenings, and a Silo experience. Here are the details.

Apple TV gears up for a big Comic Con

According to Deadline, Apple will host a two-hour panel on Saturday, July 25, with a star-packed line-up ”that includes their record breaking Emmy nominated Widow’s Bay series, the John Cena Mattel action movie Matchbox, the Ryan Reynolds movie Mayday as well as series Dark Matter and Silo.”

Apple’s Comic-Con plans will also include a “Silo Experience,” available from 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. from Friday, July 24, through Sunday, July 26, at The Lot @ 1st & J, 450 2nd Ave. in San Diego.

Additionally, Dark Matter fans will get a special sneak preview of the show’s second season on Friday, July 24, at 10:00 p.m. in Room 6DE. Deadline says star Joel Edgerton is expected to participate alongside cast Dayo Okeniyi, series creator and author Blake Crouch, writer and EP Jacquelyn Ben-Zekry, and EP Matt Tolmach.

As for its Hall H Panel, which is expected to run from 2:00 p.m. through 4:00 p.m. on Saturday, July 25, here’s what’s in store, according to Deadline:

Matchbox The Movie


Panelists: John Cena, Jessica Biel, Arturo Castro, Sam Richardson, Teyonah Parris.

Widow’s Bay


Panelists to be announced.

Dark Matter


Panelists: Blake Crouch, Matt Tolmach, Jacquelyn Ben-Zekry, Joel Edgerton, Jennifer Connelly, Dayo Okeniyi.

Mayday


Panelists: John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein.

Silo


Panelists: Graham Yost, Rebecca Ferguson, Common, Tim Robbins, Ashley Zukerman, Jessica Henwick, Alexandria Riley.

According to the report, Happy, Sad, Confused podcast host Josh Horowitz will moderate all the panels, but there is currently no information on whether Reynolds is expected to participate in the Mayday session.

For Deadline’s full report on Apple’s plans for this year’s Comic Con, follow this link.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month or part of the Apple One bundle. It features hit TV shows and movies like Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
